basis: JM-plan-v2 sections 6.3-6.4; unchanged frozen comparison v2
repeat_policy: Same label alone is insufficient if a key saved outcome reverses direction: retain label differences and opposite nonzero metric directions as conflict. Use existing v2 tolerances only; no sampling/runtime threshold changes.
replication: Two registered valid local pairs, matching labels and no opposing nonzero key metric directions; never statistical or executable eligibility

rule.compactness: height lower, envelope higher; both empty NOT_APPLICABLE; missing nonempty metrics invalidate compactness layer and reject experience
rule.hierarchy: first unequal stable completion or volume decides; otherwise count/mass Pareto; only equal loading permits height/envelope Pareto
rule.neutral: registered metric equivalence only; not action, box-set or layout identity
